newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear Tire labor contract talks underway.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear Tire labor contract talks underway.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said Monday negotiations are ongoing with the United Steelworkers of America in advance of the expiration on Saturday of a contract covering 12,000 workers at nine plants.

Goodyear Chairman Samir Gibara told shareholders at the company's annual meeting today that talks are continuing but did not make any prediction of when an agreement might be reached. Formal labor talks with the union began in March.
Gibara also told shareholders that the company, which completed the purchase of four companies in 1996, will continue to seek acquisitions.
"We plan to continue to grow through acquisitions," Gibara said. "We believe there are a number of attractive opportunities we can pursue."
In 1996, Goodyear completed acquisitions in Poland, the Philippines and South Africa and also purchased Belt Concepts of America Inc of North Carolina.
The acquisitions added annual sales totaling $770 million.

Earlier today, Goodyear reported first quarter net income of $170.4 million or $1.09 a share, up 12.3 percent from $151.8 million or $0.98 a year ago. Sales were $3.23 billion, down from $3.25 billion.
